The Bastion of Rhegard

Connects to: 03.19, 05.18, 16.16.01, 14.27.01, 18.07, 38.28 and The Duchy of Thring.

The old High Kings of Gore once looked from the windows of the high mountain towers of the Bastion of Rhegard out upon the lakes and hills of their kingdom. Now the castle is home only to mice and ravens.
